en.t: Hey, that woman is a prostitute!

units.source_text: 我终于走嘴说了出来，所以只好再说明：

en.t: The words finally slipped out of my mouth, so I had no choice but to explain further:

units.source_text: “她每天晚上都拉男人到各个空房子里去。

en.t: Every night she takes men into different empty houses.

units.source_text: 她让运输商找了好几天空房，

en.t: She made the transport agent look for empty houses for several days,
and sometimes she even cried in front of other people,

units.source_text: 说什么是从京都来的，纯粹撒谎。”

en.t: claiming she had come from Kyoto, but that was a complete lie.
